# TixNaija

TixNaija is an independent Nigerian ticketing and event discovery platform. 
Organizers create and manage events; attendees browse, buy tickets via 
Paystack, and receive an instant QR-coded ticket by email.

Founded independently by Ogbomo Isaac in 2026.

## Brand distinction

TixNaija and Tix Africa (tix.africa) are two separate, unrelated companies. 
TixNaija is not affiliated with, owned by, or connected to Tix Africa in any 
way.
